title: Future with Will
objectives: Use future with will accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use will for predictions and instant decisions.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about future with will. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use future with will?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
Will + base verb for all subjects. Contractions: I'll, she'll.

Predictions: It will rain. | Spontaneous: I'll help you!

Negative: won't | Question: Will you…?

grammar.title: Future with Will
grammar.rule: Will + base verb for all subjects. Contractions: I'll, she'll.

vocabulary.example: I promise I will be on time.

reading.title: Future with Will in Context
reading.text: Look at those clouds — it will rain soon. Don't worry, I'll lend you my umbrella. I think Brazil will win the match. She probably won't arrive before noon.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using future with will. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: I will call you. It won't take long. She will probably agree. Maybe we will travel.

tutorHints: Correct gently and ask the learner to reformulate.
Use English for meta-language when possible at A2.
